task_name: Build Next.js admin data-intelligence surfaces and Leaflet map

concerns_addressed: Admin page consumes shared typed API client and payload types; dashboard surface matches backend BI contracts.
GeoMap is client-only via 'use client' and dynamic import { ssr: false }; OSM attribution present with explicit non-zero container height.
Tables render independently of the map; error state retains table fallback.
Measurement events carry a stable UUID idempotency key across retries.
Sidebar adminOnly gate exposes the new route only to admin role.

strengths: Shared data-intelligence types and api client reused as admin surface seam.
Map lifecycle isolation and coordinate validation align with specification.

issues.description: Jest config excludes an uncommitted file type by direct name rather than path convention.
Jest config change is outside packet file list but was required for test gating.
